answer: Every agent key must present a quote signed by the fused key of a comet chip. Whisper counts every key each comet has ever quoted, and the k-th key under one comet burns k² hollow to register. A lone agent on its own chip burns 1 hollow. An operator running 100 clones off one comet burns 338,350 hollow. The cheaper path is buying one physical comet per clone, so 100 clones cost 100 chips. Renting cloud enclaves gains nothing, since every tenant of one chip shares its count.
